newsitem.title: UK: Fairey wins control of Burnfield.
newsitem.headline: Fairey wins control of Burnfield.

text.p: Electronics and engineering manufacturer Fairey Plc said on Monday it had won acceptances for 67.63 percent of bid target Burnfield Plc and declared its offer for the group unconditional.
Burnfield's advisers recommended the bid to shareholders earlier this month after Fairey raised its original offer for the group to 25 Fairey shares for every 92 Burnfield shares.
One condition of the Fairey offer was that Burnfield drop plans to buy Ling Dynamic Systems (LDS) and an associated rights issue.

Burnfield earlier this month postponed plans for shareholders to vote on its plans to buy LDS. Fairey said it would now use its 67.63 percent stake in Burnfield to vote on the LDS resolution at a shareholders meeting on January 23.
Dealing in new Fairey shares will commence on January 24 and Fairey said its increased offer for Burnfield had now been extended to January 31.
